subject.title: Expose maxMissedJobsPerRestart and missedJobStaggerMs in cron config

question: Should OpenClaw expose restart catch-up controls in public cron config, and should the supported shape be the existing global max/stagger knobs, a skip/catch-up policy, or no new public config?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the repository policy treats new config/default surfaces as compatibility-sensitive and the choice changes restart behavior for existing scheduled jobs.

options.title: Expose Narrow Global Controls
options.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up settings based on the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit semantics for disabling immediate catch-up.

options.title: Design A Skip Policy First
options.body: Prefer a global or per-job skipMissedRuns-style policy before implementation, preserving current catch-up defaults for existing users.

options.title: Keep Controls Internal
options.body: Decline new public config for now and document the current restart catch-up behavior and operational workarounds.

recommendation.title: Expose Narrow Global Controls
recommendation.body: Approve documented global cron restart catch-up settings based on the existing internal max/stagger behavior, including explicit semantics for disabling immediate catch-up.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about public config and scheduler semantics, and steipete is tied to the original catch-up merge plus current adjacent cron/config history.
